CustomField.label: Value
CustomField.description: What the field is compared with. Numbers as 1234.5; dates as 2026-12-31, TODAY, TODAY+7 or TODAY-30; checkboxes as true or false; lookups and owners as a record Id, or $User for the person viewing the grid. Leave blank for Is blank and Is not blank.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: What to compare with. Examples: 1000, 2026-12-31, TODAY+7, true, or $User for the current user. Leave blank for Is blank and Is not blank.
